subject: Interviewer gap triage: proxy matrix and candidate timing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia@olivetech.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Interviewer gap triage: proxy matrix and candidate timing

Hi team,

We have a shortfall on the panel for Jordan Miles (SDE II candidate) next Tuesday 9/7, 10:00–11:30am PT. The scheduled backend system-design interviewer had an emergency and is out. The panel needs a senior systems/infra engineerto assess architecture and scale.

Constraints:
- Keep panel size <= 4 (hiring manager + 2 technical + 1 behavioral).
- Prefer someone with distributed systems experience and interview calibration with our rubric.
- Candidate is PST-based; earliest start is 10:00am PT.

Ask: Can folks indicate availability and a proxy priority (1/2/3) by EOD today so I can lock the calendar and share interview owner for the debrief? Ive attached the current proxy matrix draft and the candidate resume.

Attachments: candidate_resume.pdf, draft_proxy_matrix.xlsx

Thanks — Ill consolidate and set the final invite once I have commitments.

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Recruiting Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia@olivetech.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Interviewer gap triage: proxy matrix and candidate timing

On 2027-09-01, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> We have a shortfall on the panel for Jordan Miles (SDE II candidate) next Tuesday 9/7, 10:00–11:30am PT. The scheduled backend system-design interviewer had an emergency and is out.

Thanks for the heads-up. I updated the matrix with who can cover which slot and added two fallback proxies. Quick summary below — full details in attached proxy_matrix_v2.xlsx: 

- Primary cover (system-design): Karthik Iyer (can do 10:00–11:30 PT; calibrated)
- Secondary cover: Ben Carter (can do 10:30–11:30 PT; prefers to do carry-forward of behavioral if we shift times)
- Tertiary/float: Lauren Bishop (can join 10:00–10:40 PT for architecture segment only)

If Karthik needs to jump between two interviews, Ben can take the deeper architecture questions and I can own the debrief to keep calibration consistent. Suggest we keep the hiring manager in the loop and make Marissa the debrief owner unless someone else prefers it.

Notes:
- If we shift the session 30 minutes earlier to 9:30 PT, we open up another senior option (Marcus Lin), but that will require candidate confirmation.
- Please add your commit level next to your name in the sheet (1 = will definitely cover, 2 = likely, 3 = possible).

Marissa Cole
Staffing Lead, Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proxy_matrix_v2.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Interviewer gap triage: proxy matrix and candidate timing

I can take primary for the system-design slot — confirmed 10:00–11:30 PT. Im fine owning the deeper architecture questions; if I need to split, Ben can handle scale / capacity and Marissa can run the debrief.

Also propose we rotate interview ownership for consecutive onsite days so no single interviewer takes too many consecutive debriefs (keeps calibration fresh). Happy to be backup for 9/30 shift if we end up moving the block earlier.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer (Interview Panelist)
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Park <olivia@olivetech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T13:10:00Z

Thanks — Jordan confirms availability for 9/7, 10:00–11:30 PT. Ive added a calendar hold here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=0example-calendar-link
